newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar closes slightly down in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar closes slightly down in quiet trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed slightly lower against the U.S. dollar on Wednesday in quiet trade and dealers expected listless trading to continue in the near term.
The local unit closed at T$27.501 against Tuesday's T$27.500 close. Turnover was US$126 million.

Slightly firmer short-term interest rates in the domestic money market pulled the local unit to an intra-day high of T$27.497, but minor month-end commercial demand for the U.S. dollar balanced the supply, dealers said.
"Unless some big news emerges, the quiet market will continue for some time," said one dealer.
A T$27.48-52 range was seen for Thursday.
